To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the grain boundary states in undoped polysilicons are responsible for the leakage current at low injection level, and that at high injection levels the deep level 0.182eV is formed.
the electrical properties of n+-i-p diode structures depend on the ion-implanted layer and the structure of grain boundary states.

the current-voltage (IV) characteristics, the capacitance-frequency (CV) and capacitance-temperature (CT) characteristics of the n+-i-p diodes are determined by the grain boundary states and deep centres of polysilicon material.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of the electrical properties of undoped polysillicon material and polysilicon n-i-p junctions.
the investigation of the electronic properties of polysillicon material, and the effect of the ion implantation step on the electrical characteristics of n+-i-p silicon junctions.
the study of the electrical properties of polysillicon n+-i-p diodes, with the purpose to investigate the structure and defects in polysilicon material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the polysilicon material is of high quality, and that the junctions are well formed and have low leakage current.
the deep level 0.182 is a defect in the polysilicon material, not related to the grain boundary structure.
the polysilicon material is of a very high purity and the junctions are of a good quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the polysilicon material has a high density of defects, the defects are not distributed uniformly in the material and the structure of these defects changes after application of a high injection level.
the grain boundary states are the dominant factor controlling the diode current and the deep centres are the main factor controlling the junction capacitance.
the grain boundary states are responsible for the low injection level and the deep level is responsible for high injection level in the I-V characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the polysilicon material is a good candidate for solar cell applications.
the polysilicon material has a high density of defects and the defects are not homogeneously distributed in the material.
the deep levels in undoped polysililicon can be changed by the application of high injection levels.
